description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability granted by A Realm Reborn by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Graveborn token
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability granted by A Realm Reborn by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
